instruction: Create a folder on the bookmarks bar in Chrome with the name 'My Projects'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a bookmark folder named 'My Projects' on the bookmarks bar. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names type). No custom functions needed - reuses official getter/metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome bookmarks file and extracts bookmark structure
Metric correctly filters for folders (type=='folder') on bookmark bar, not bookmark URLs
Metric uses subset check which correctly allows additional folders while verifying 'My Projects' exists
Expected value correctly specifies the folder name to verify
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are persisted to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement from instruction
